title: Chapter 973
paragraphs: Chapter 973
241st Episode: Rescue (2)
At that time, Jin was sitting face to face with Luna in the training ground of Tikan Palace, meditating.
"Look with the eye of your mind, sister."
Jin spoke in a playful voice, causing a vein to pop on Luna's forehead.
"What? What did you say?"
"This is not the time to get angry, sister. If you look with the eye of your mind, you will find the answer."
"This brat, really. I never thought I would be repaid like this for the wholehearted meditation training I provided you when you were a student."
Jin laughed slyly, seemingly satisfied with Luna's reaction.
The reason the two were in the training ground was no other.
-(P.S.: Luna could do with experiencing a harsh defeat at least once. Youngest, you help her.)
The message Khan brought this time. In the letter, Chiron ordered Jin to help Luna and make her experience a 'harsh defeat.'
However, since no one knew when a war might break out, a real sword duel was out of the question. The two were dueling through meditation.
Both being at the level of enlightenment or close to it, they could achieve effects similar to a real duel just through that, but regret was inevitable.

"It feels like I could reach it if I break through one thin and transparent wall... I probably have to overcome a life-or-death crossroads. But even if I immerse myself in meditation, it's hard to recreate the sense of crisis in an actual battle."
All the enlightened ones Jin had 'directly' witnessed or experienced so far shared the same feature.
Both Ron and Jin had reached enlightenment by overcoming desperate crises.

"Sister, in my opinion, it would be better not to obsess over the sense of crisis. Ron and I reached enlightenment through crisis, but I heard that father and my half-brother did not. And when I look at you, I think you resemble them more."
"But father and your four Divine Kings brothers must have overcome such crises several times. Think about it, I've hardly ever faced such a crisis since I was born."
She had never felt a serious threat to her life.

It was true. Luna had lived only as an unrivaled beast with no natural enemies. Most people like that eventually hit a massive wall and realize the vastness of the sky, but Luna never experienced that.
The 'stronger people' around her, like Chiron, felt vaguely reachable if she just lived long enough. It was the same when she thought about her younger brother in front of her now.

Even in the Black Sea, one could say that Luna had a time where she crossed the line of death, but even then, Shi Rong and the former Black Knights were always with her. It was only then that Luna had received protection from others for the first time.

“Before following my father on the Black Sea expedition, I almost never felt a crisis, and although the situation in the Black Sea was really bad, it only felt like a crisis that could somehow be overcome. Until recently, there wasn't even a dangerous moment during the war with the demon realm.”
“Hmm, I suppose so.”
“What do you think was the biggest crisis in my life? It was the day I saved you from Andrei Zipple, youngest brother. I strained a bit to cut the magical stone, and in the end, I needed your help.”
Jin briefly recalled the memory of that day.
“...Listening to you say that, it seems like it wasn't a big deal for you. Even if I hadn't helped, you would have survived easily.”
“That's right. Of course, I would have been a little hurt if you weren't there.”
It's no wonder that Shi Rong said Luna needed to experience a harsh defeat. Ascending to Transcendence without defeat was only possible for someone with a massive divine stature, like Elona.
To begin with, Elona was referred to as Transcendent because there was no other term for her; she was closer to a god embodying the will of the sun itself.
‘Certainly... To reach Transcendence, Luna will need that kind of experience, teetering on the brink of life and death.’
But they could not really spar for such training, nor could they intentionally push Luna into enemy territory and put her in danger.
“What about first perfecting your understanding of the red energy's frequency limits? Training with the red power can be done without a sparring partner.”

“I am thinking about that as well. If the explosion of red energy can be called a crisis, then it could be considered a crisis... but it's not absolutely uncontrollable either. Damn, it's frustrating!”
Just as Luna shouted like that, Ameris came to the training ground.
“You're talking nonsense, Luna.”
“Ameris. Haha... Yes, I guess so.”
“Don't rush your thoughts. I lost so much of my old strength and didn't act impatiently, so learn from me.”
“I will, Ameris. But why have you come?”
“It seems that there's something I need to tell Jin, so I came to find him. Luna, don't slack off, listen too.”
“Ameris, what is it?”
“It appears that some powerful beings are battling near the magical barrier right now.”
“What?”
“Underground? Could there be remnants of the earth in the demon realm? That's not possible.”
Ameris shook her head.
"That's not it. It's not a complete underground battle, but a battle taking place in the middle layer. I was doubtful at first, but now I'm sure."

Although most of the sensations of the heyday that had spread throughout the surface and underground had been lost, the current battle that spread in the middle layer of Meisil was big enough for even Ameris to feel at the moment.
"...Then, it must be the enemy tribe."

"I think so too, Jin. However, I'm still focusing and trying to read the situation, but it doesn't seem like it's just the energy of the enemy tribe. Whether it's the strongest in Zipple, or Kinzelo, or something else, I don't know."
"We'll have to go and check it ourselves. What the enemies are doing."
"Yes, it may be a great opportunity or a danger. We can leave the surface to Murakan for a while, and the two of us can go together."

Jin immediately informed the commanders of the situation and headed for the Red Owl. Ameris continued to focus on the sensations near Bongmabeok, roughly pinpointing the location. Valeria found the coordinates by listening to Ameris's explanation.
"According to Ameris's description, the coordinates lead to an uninhabited island in the North Sea of the Ruteran Federation."
An uninhabited island in the North Sea of the Ruteran Federation. That place was precisely the space used as a hideout until the royal family fell.
Below the uninhabited island were several 'underground passages' used by the ancient Blue Plutonian tribe, and the royal family had hidden from the world's great powers through them.
"Ruteran Federation... It's a sensitive issue. If the youngest and I go there and get mixed up with others, a war could start right away."
"It's okay, older sister. The possibility of having troops deployed on this uninhabited island is low anyway."
"If they exist, we'll just eliminate them?"

"That's right. If there are troops, it means that the uninhabited island is one of Zipple's secret agencies, which is not bad in itself. But it seems like a deserted uninhabited island. It's too far from the central areas that Zipple directly manages."
"You're right. Let's go, youngest."
Jin, Luna, and Ameris climbed onto the Red Owl. The Red Owl quickly dropped the three of them onto an uninhabited island in the northern part of the Ruteran Federation.
Upon arrival, as Jin expected, it really looked like a deserted island. There was no federal force to be found.
However, the three were able to smell a faint scent of blood drifting around the island. It was a smell that only someone with highly developed senses like them could detect.
"Huh, this is."
Following the scent of blood, a cave was revealed, and the inside of the cave was decorated in the style of the basement.
"This was the royal family's hideout..."
"Is it abandoned? The smell of blood is coming from this room. Is this... the corpse of the ancient royal tribe...?"
As Luna opened the door affixed to the wall, the sealed corpses of the Blue Plutonian people were revealed.
Inside the cave, Jin and Luna saw a few devices and mechanisms they had never seen before. But Ameris immediately recognized them as ancient relics.

"Luna, those are Blue Plutonian corpses. Ah, seeing these brings back some memories. Jin, these are devices used to open the passages that the Blue Plutonian used. And as soon as we arrived here, I can feel the battle intensifying."
Now Jin and Luna were also feeling the intense vibrations rising from the underground mid-level.
"I'll handle the devices here. You two go ahead."
Ameris said, touching a statue in the center of the cave. Ancient characters inscribed on the statue were moving around at her touch.
"Understood, Lady Ameris."

"Stand here, and the device will take you directly to where the battle is happening. Let's see... Mei... Meisil. Yes, Meisil, there was such a city. It appears that the royal family has been attacked by the Red Plutonian. The royals must have been trading with the Red Plutonian, using these Blue Plutonian corpses."

As Jin and Luna stood on the circular ancient characters drawn on the floor, the devices resonated and spatial leap began. A blue passage opened below the ancient characters, and the two were sucked into it, as if falling.
They were able to reach near Meisil immediately.
They should have been transported directly inside the Meisil fortress, but the enemy brainwaves emitted by the Red Plutonian aerial fortresses were obstructing the spatial leap.
But even from a considerable distance, they could easily grasp the situation in the city of Meisil.
The entire sky was filled with red and blue lightning.
'Red lightning is spread by Red Plutonian's aerial fortresses and warships, and the blue lightning is...'
Jin shifted his gaze to find the owner of the blue lightning. He was facing the fortress behind, and even though it was his first time seeing him, he instantly recognized who he was.
"Luke... the former warrior of the Myeong King clan. The High Priest of the Sun Religion, whom Lady Ayula warned against. It's definitely him."
"Indeed, it's him. But there's another one using blue lightning; who's that?"
Eltiet.

He was enduring Pibil's bombardment, his body riddled with wounds. He looked as if he might collapse at any moment, and although Luke seemed much more at ease, he didn't appear to have any intention of helping him.
"It's clear that he's an enemy of the Red Plutonian since they're trying to kill him, and Luke doesn't seem to care about him, so he's probably not an ally of the Sun Religion either."
"Then we should first rescue that friend and find out what's going on."
"I agree, Brother. Let's go."
